title: Image management is tedious
summary: It only operates on one page worth of images, there is no immediately apparent way of showing untagged images and there is no indicator of how many images (or pages) there are. This makes it rather tedious to delete stale or unused images. What's really needed is a image lifecycle policy feature that would let me specify somthing like "automatically delete untagged index images and the images they refer to if all underlying (non-index) images were last pulled more than a month ago"
